messages.author: 1667ac6354bdba89
messages.subject: Access to spark.rstudio.com:8787/auth-sign-in ?
parts:
Hello, is it possible to get a login to this Shiny Server at spark.rstudio.com:8787/auth-sign-in so I can deploy public apps? 

Or is this where you deploy if you are on the alpha/beta of http://shinyapps.io/ ? (My application is pending)

I have a local Shiny Server running, but this is on a private server, so want to move some over to public.

Yours sincerely,
Mark

messages.subject: Re: Access to spark.rstudio.com:8787/auth-sign-in ?

Hi Mark,

We'll slowly be winding down Spark and Glimmer this year in favor or ShinyApps.io. You can see the instructions for getting registered and setup here: http://www.rstudio.com/shiny/hosted/

Jeff
